text: be sure you also @GUIDING_LIGHT.md in your plan
resolution: Two things from the user: (1) folded GUIDING_LIGHT.md into the approved loader plan as a governing 'Guiding Light alignment' section — the loader move is the creed (delete the VM from the frame loop; combat as flat content-addressed lumps run by fixed Zig systems; Stage 2 is systems-driven-by-data not ported code; keep the chance/perception tables as FACTORS not a baked product; declarative never Turing-complete). (2) Fixed the backwards NPC vision cones in combat-arena.tsx: ConeMesh offset/rotation used the perception-heading convention (yaw+180), which put the cone BEHIND the figure; now it uses the figure facing (-Z at yaw0 = [-sin yaw,-cos yaw]) so the cone points where the NPC actually looks and where inVisionCone checks. esbuild bundle clean.
